description: This file contains the implementation of advanced QR code segment encoding logic, including functions for optimal segmentation, mode switching, and kanji encoding, specific to QR code generation.

classes.name: QrSegmentAdvanced
classes.description: Provides advanced QR code segmentation algorithms, including optimal segment list creation and kanji encoding.

methods.name: makeSegmentsOptimally
methods.description: Creates an optimal list of QR code segments for a given Unicode string, considering version and error correction constraints.

methods.name: makeSegmentsOptimally (private)
methods.description: Internal method to generate a list of segments optimized for a specific version.

methods.name: computeBitCosts
methods.description: Calculates the cost in bits for encoding segments in different modes, used for dynamic programming optimization.

methods.name: computeCharacterModes
methods.description: Determines the optimal mode for each character by working backwards from the end, based on bit costs.

methods.name: splitIntoSegments
methods.description: Splits byte data into segments based on computed character modes.

methods.name: isAlphanumeric
methods.description: Checks if a character can be encoded in alphanumeric mode.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a character can be encoded in numeric mode.

methods.name: makeKanjiSegment
methods.description: Encodes a string as a kanji mode segment, throwing if characters are not encodable.

methods.name: isEncodableAsKanji
methods.description: Tests if a string can be encoded entirely in kanji mode.
